title: Mutton Broth
description: Mutton Broth is a classic Continental soup made by slowly simmering mutton bones, meat, and aromatic vegetables to create a rich, clear, and flavorful broth. Light yet nourishing, it is perfect as a starter or as a base for other soups.

ingredients.title: For the Broth
items: Mutton bones with some meat – 500 g

ingredients.title: For Garnish
items: Julienned carrots or herbs (parsley or chives)
Olive oil or truffle oil – light drizzle (optional)

instruction.title: Step 1 – Roast the Bones
steps: Place mutton bones on a baking tray and roast for 20–25 minutes until golden brown.

instruction.title: Step 2 – Prepare the Broth
steps: In a large pot, combine roasted bones, mutton meat, onion, carrot, celery, leek, garlic, bay leaf, thyme, parsley, peppercorns, and cloves.
Cover with 2 liters of cold water.

instruction.title: Step 3 – Simmer Slowly
steps: Skim off any foam or impurities.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 2–2.5 hours.
Maintain a gentle simmer; avoid rapid boiling to keep the broth clear.

instruction.title: Step 4 – Strain the Broth
steps: Strain through a fine sieve or cheesecloth for a clear broth.

instruction.title: Step 5 – Season and Finish
steps: Optional: skim off excess fat for a cleaner finish or leave a little for richness.

instruction.title: Step 6 – Serve
steps: Garnish with finely chopped herbs, thin julienned vegetables, or a few drops of premium olive or truffle oil.

servingSuggestions.title: Serving Suggestions
items: Serve hot with crusty bread or dinner rolls.
Use as a base for continental mutton soups and stews.
Garnish with fresh herbs and julienned vegetables before serving.

chefTips: Roast the bones for a deeper, nuttier flavor.
Slow, gentle simmering is key to producing a crystal-clear broth.
For extra richness, add a splash of dry white wine during simmering.
Skim the surface regularly to keep the broth clear and refined.
